verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway lets users control what MCP calls an agent can make and enable/disable individual tools, which approximates least-privilege access, and it supports OAuth 2.1 for servers, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege API credentials or tokens for agents themselves. Missing for 10: dedicated credential/token issuance flow for agents, scoping documentation (e.g., per-agent API keys with defined permissions), and any independent confirmation of this capability.
